design_detail: tax on total wealth ("na ukupno bogatstvo") announced as part of a set of taxes on accumulated wealth
quote_original: veće oporezivanje nagomilanog bogatstva ovih grupa kroz porez na imovinu u kojoj se ne živi, na ukupno bogatstvo i porez na nasleđe i poklon
quote_en: Increased taxation of the accumulated wealth of these groups through a tax on property not lived in, on total wealth and on inheritance and gifts
source_title: Država ponovo propustila priliku za pravedan poreski sistem u celosti
grading_note: Names a tax on total wealth among three taxes it will raise; no rate or threshold, and the tax on property not lived in and the inheritance tax are outside the definition.

design_detail: programme refers to a tax on net worldwide wealth ("porez na neto svetsku imovinu") as the model for taxing luxury assets held abroad
quote_original: Takođe, kao i u slučaju poreza na neto svetsku imovinu, poreski zahvat bi trebalo proširiti na sve ovakve oblike imovine koje naši rezidenti poseduju, posredno ili neposredno, bilo gde na planeti.
quote_en: Also, as with the tax on net worldwide wealth, the levy should be extended to all such assets that our residents own, directly or indirectly, anywhere on the planet.
grading_note: The programme mentions the net worldwide wealth tax only in passing, while proposing a value-based tax on vehicles, boats and aircraft; its own property-tax and inheritance reforms are outside the definition. Implied support.

design_detail: higher taxation of the extremely rich on total wealth, not only income; illustrated with 2% on the wealth of the 3,000 richest billionaires
quote_original: Simović kao ključnu neophodnu promenu vidi upravo promenu poreske politike koja bi omogućila veće oporezivanje ekstremno bogatih. I to ne samo njihovog dohotka, već ukupnog bogatstva.
quote_en: Simović sees the key change as a tax policy that would tax the extremely rich more, and not only their income but their total wealth.
source_title: Raslojavanje u našoj zemlji prati svetske trendove: Polovina stanovništva Srbije ima prihode kao jedan odsto najbogatijih
grading_note: Interview with the reporter paraphrasing his position; his own quoted words give the 2% on billionaires example. Named wealth tax, no Serbian rate or threshold.

design_detail: progressive tax on wealth, as proposed in the Berlin Declaration of 29 May 2024
quote_original: Deklaracija predlaže oporezivanje bogatstva (a ne samo prihoda) i to po progresivnoj stopi.
quote_en: The Declaration proposes taxing wealth (and not only income), at a progressive rate.
grading_note: Opinion column that explains and defends the declaration's progressive wealth tax and applies it to Serbia; the author does not write in the first person that he backs it, so graded C.

design_detail: criticises the absence of a wealth and luxury tax in Serbia
quote_original: poreska politika koja i pored ekstremnog bogatstva novokomponovane elite ne poznaje porez na bogatstvo i luksuz
quote_en: Tax policy that, despite the extreme wealth of the new elite, does not know a tax on wealth and luxury
source_title: Dveri: Povlašćeni položaj stranaca je razlog za gubitak ekonomskog suvereniteta Srbije
grading_note: Names the missing wealth tax as a cause of poverty, without saying she would introduce one; reported by Beta as a statement of the Dveri vice-president.
